name: Solar
description: '''Kim Yong-sun''' ({{Korean|hangul=김용선}}; born February 21, 1991), known professionally as '''Solar''' ({{Korean|hangul=솔라|labels=no}}), is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and actress signed to [[RBW (company)|RBW]]. She is the leader of the girl group [[Mamamoo]] and its sub-unit [[Mamamoo+]]. She made her solo debut with the single "[[Spit It Out (Solar song)|Spit It Out]]" in 2020 and subsequently released the extended plays ''[[Face (Solar EP)|容: Face]]'' (2022) and ''[[Colours (EP)|Colours]]'' (2024). She made her musical theatre debut in ''[[Mata Hari (Wildhorn musical)|Mata Hari]]'' in 2022 and later appeared in ''[[Notre-Dame de Paris (musical)|Notre-Dame de Paris]]''. In 2025, she made her film debut in the horror film ''[[The Cursed (2025 film)|The Cursed]]'' and released her first Chinese-language single "Floating Free".
